page.layout: One page of text. Running head at top; page number 64 at top left. Heading CAP. III. and title De secunda figura. Opening paragraph with large initial S. Then a diagram of three triangles (I, II, III) with braces, the outline is given as diagram lines. Left margin note "Figura secunda." and "Triangulus" beside the first triangle. Closing paragraph at foot with signature I. Aa at bottom right.

main_text.head: CAP. III.
De secunda figura.

p.i: SEcunda figura continet praedicata respectiva, quae ita habent:

main_text.p: Figura est circularis, sed alio modo quam prima.

page.notes: Diagram labels are reduced to their outline; the braces and the letters I, II, III, B, C, D, E, F, G are as printed. The catchword line and the signature are read from the foot of the page; the heading CAP. III. is printed in small capitals.
